p25.002: The Messenger Hosts of Space hold the middle place in the family of the Infinite Spirit. They act as a bridge between the higher personalities and the ministering spirits. There are seven groups of them: the Havona Servitals, the Universal Conciliators, the Technical Advisers, the Custodians of Records on Paradise, the Celestial Recorders, the Morontia Companions, and the Paradise Companions. Of these, the servitals, the conciliators, and the morontia companions were made that way from the start, and the other four are positions that angels have risen to by gaining experience.
p25.004: The Havona Servitals are called servitals, but they are never lowly servants. In the spiritual world there is no such thing as menial work; all service is holy. They are beings made by the Seven Master Spirits and the Seven Supreme Power Directors together, and they appear in groups of a thousand. Of these, three out of four are spiritual beings, and one is a little closer to the material.
p25.005: After being trained in Havona, the servitals work on the superuniverse education worlds, where ascending humans do their last studies before entering Havona. There they become our friends and give us the assurance that we will surely graduate to the eternal worlds. This paper says that what matters at the final judgment is not material success or how much we have achieved. The words we will hear then are, “⟦Q 25:1.6⟧Well done, good and faithful servant⟦/Q⟧”. What matters is whether we were faithful over a few essential things.
p25.007: Each time one Havona Servital is made, one Universal Conciliator is born in each of the seven superuniverses along with it. Each superuniverse mirrors the nature of the Master Spirit who rules it, so the conciliators there take after that nature too.
p25.008: From birth, the conciliators form teams of four. There is the judge-arbiter, who leads the hearing; the spirit-advocate, who protects everyone's rights and presents the evidence; the divine executioner, who actually carries out the decisions; and the recorder, who keeps the record. They fly about three times as fast as the seraphim (one order of angels) and serve as traveling courts that quickly settle the small disputes of the worlds. They do not deal with matters of eternal destiny, but the verdicts in the cases they take on are always unanimous and final.
p25.010: The conciliators are so trustworthy that not one of them has ever rebelled. They begin their work on small worlds like Urantia and rise step by step through the systems, the constellations, and the local universes all the way to the superuniverses. The higher they go, the more they change from judges who settle disputes into teachers who teach wisdom and tolerance so that disputes do not arise. This paper says that the more we learn, the more we come to respect the knowledge, experience, and opinions of others.
p25.011: The Creators could have made the local universes perfect like Havona, but they chose universes where beings with the freedom to choose would live. Where there is freedom, misunderstandings are bound to happen, so they also provided the conciliators to settle those differences fairly. The four conciliators of a team never part; they serve together forever.
p25.013: The Technical Advisers are the legal experts of the spiritual world. At first the Infinite Spirit started this group by choosing one million angels with the most orderly minds, and since then many orders of angels with real experience, as well as some ascending humans and midwayers, have joined this work. They usually work in groups of seven, and through long training they become living law libraries of time and space.
p25.014: This paper says that we ascenders, too, will be both students who learn and teachers who teach all the way to Paradise. Only when we can pass a truth we have learned on to others are we considered to truly have it. The Technical Advisers believe that there is a best and right way to do everything, and they help us find that way. This kind of wisdom cannot be handed to someone ready-made; it grows only through experience.
p25.015: 5. The Custodians of Records on Paradise
p25.016: The Custodians of Records on Paradise are senior recorders chosen from among the supernaphim (a high order of angels) of Havona, and they guard the official record archives of Paradise. On the planets, the recording angels begin all records, and important events are passed up through the local universe and the superuniverse all the way to Paradise, where they are summarized and kept. The local universes have many written records, and Paradise has many living records held in the minds of beings.
p25.018: The Celestial Recorders are seraphim who have risen from the local universes. They have a special ability to make both a spiritual record and a semimaterial copy, so that everyone, from material beings to high spirits, can see the records. So as we rise, we too can read the history of the worlds of each stage at any time. Not one of these recorders has ever rebelled or made a false record.
p25.020: The Morontia Companions are children of the local universe Mother Spirit, and they are friends to those who live the morontia life (the stage between material and spiritual life) after death. They do not take over the work of the guardian angels, but they warmly welcome those who are just beginning the long journey and lead them in play. This paper says that all along the road to Paradise there will always be times of rest and spiritual play. They work only in the local universe, so we will truly be sorry to say goodbye to them when we leave it.
p25.022: The Paradise Companions are beings chosen from many orders of angels, and on Paradise they have no special job except to be friends who keep us company. That is because the Creators know well that it is “⟦Q 25:8.4⟧not good for man to be alone⟦/Q⟧”. If we arrive on Paradise alone, a companion will gladly greet us when we wake from the last sleep. They have carefully studied the path we have traveled ahead of time, so they quickly become good friends.
p25.023: Even when a pilgrim who has failed for a time in the adventure of finding God in Havona must go back to the worlds of time, a Paradise Companion goes along, comforts and encourages him, and stays by his side until he comes back up. A guardian angel sometimes chooses on her own to go back with her longtime companion as well. This story, that even when we fail we are not abandoned and someone stays with us to the end, gives us strength to get back up when we fall.
p26.002: The supernaphim are ministering spirits, that is, angels, who work on Paradise and in the central universe. They are the highest order among the angel hosts. Ministering spirits like these can be found everywhere, from Paradise all the way to the worlds of time and space where we live, and there is no place outside their care.
p26.004: Angels are companions and friends to every being climbing up through the universe. Every angel has a unique personality, enjoys rest and pleasure, and loves company much more than humans do. The ministering spirits include the supernaphim, the seconaphim, the tertiaphim, the omniaphim, the seraphim, the cherubim and sanobim, and the midway creatures. The supernaphim work in the central universe; the seconaphim, tertiaphim, and omniaphim work in the superuniverses; and the seraphim and cherubim work in our local universe.
p26.005: They are all linked together and form an unbroken chain that helps everyone who seeks to go to God the Father. Some angels can work only in pairs, and then each is called the complement of the other. Angels do not eat food; they live on the spiritual energy of the universe circuits, and they take in knowledge and wisdom much as they take in life energy.
p26.007: The supernaphim are made in three orders: primary, secondary, and tertiary. The primary supernaphim are beings made directly by the Infinite Spirit, and on Paradise they help the Paradise Citizens and the pilgrims who have come up understand one another. The secondary supernaphim come from the Seven Master Spirits and lead the pilgrims on the seven circuits of Havona, and the tertiary supernaphim come from the Seven Circuit Spirits, who are in charge of the circuits of Havona. The tertiary supernaphim came first, and the secondary supernaphim began to be made when Grandfanda, the first human pilgrim, arrived in Havona.
p26.009: In Havona (the perfect central universe around Paradise) there are a billion worlds of learning, arranged in seven round circuits. Pilgrims who have come up from the superuniverses move inward from the seventh, outer circuit, and pilgrims who have come down from Paradise move outward from the inside. Some of the training worlds of the local universe may be skipped, but no one may skip any of the seven circuits of Havona.
p26.010: Here the tertiary supernaphim divide many jobs among themselves. There are the harmony supervisors, who help everything go smoothly; the chief recorders, who keep records in triplicate; the broadcasters, who send and receive news; the messengers, who carry news in person; the intelligence co-ordinators, the “⟦Q 26:3.8⟧living newspapers⟦/Q⟧” who keep every inhabitant up to date; the transport personalities, who help with travel; and the reserve corps, who help when needed.
p26.012: The secondary supernaphim work on the seven circuits of Havona. The pilgrim helpers, the supremacy guides, the Trinity guides, the Son finders, the Father guides, the counselors and advisers, and the complements of rest take charge of the pilgrims, one circuit after another. We people of Urantia will be guided by supernaphim who came from the Master Spirit who rules our superuniverse, so they can understand and comfort us better than anyone.
p26.013: When a pilgrim first arrives in Havona, he has only one kind of perfection: perfection of purpose. The Father has commanded, “⟦Q 26:4.12⟧Be you perfect, even as I am perfect.⟦/Q⟧” and the whole universe is helping to fulfill this command. By then our faith will have been tested enough that no disappointment can shake it. This paper says that the ability to understand is the passport to Paradise, and the willingness to believe is the key to Havona.
p26.015: The pilgrim helpers are the warm beings who are the first to greet pilgrims who have come a long way. On the outer circuit they teach the basic courses about the Trinity, the relationship between the Father and the Son, and the Infinite Spirit. Long before coming to Havona, the pilgrims learned how not to lose heart even in disappointment and difficulty. Their battle cry was, “⟦Q 26:5.3⟧In liaison with God, nothing—absolutely nothing—is impossible.⟦/Q⟧” In Havona what matters is not how much time it took but what was actually achieved, and when a pilgrim is ready, he moves on to the next circuit.
p26.017: A pilgrim who enters the sixth circuit is called a “⟦Q 26:6.1⟧spiritual graduate⟦/Q⟧” and comes under the care of the supremacy guides. Here they come to a new awareness of God the Supreme, who ties the evolving universe together. The Supreme Being cannot be seen, but the pilgrims go through a change in which their thinking and spiritual insight grow greatly. This paper says it seems as if God the Supreme is lovingly raising up his own children.
p26.019: On the fifth circuit the pilgrim becomes one of the “⟦Q 26:7.1⟧candidates for the Deity adventure⟦/Q⟧” and gets ready, with the Trinity guides, for the great adventure of finding God. Here they learn what true study and mental effort really are. The guides give each pilgrim their full attention and love. When the preparation is over, the pilgrim sets out with three companions on a trial trip to Paradise and first takes up the challenge of recognizing the Infinite Spirit as a person. This challenge almost never fails.
p26.021: The fourth circuit is also called the “⟦Q 26:8.1⟧circuit of the Sons⟦/Q⟧”. Here, with the help of the Son finders, the pilgrims get ready to recognize the Eternal Son. This circuit is also where pilgrims who have come down from Paradise and pilgrims who have come up understand each other truly for the first time.
p26.022: Not many pilgrims fail in the adventure of finding God, but now and then some do. But on Paradise disappointment is never thought of as defeat, and delay is never something to be ashamed of. No one is scolded. Those who fail serve in the worlds of space for at least a thousand years and prepare again, and on the second attempt they always succeed.
p26.024: On the third circuit the most experienced guides, the Father guides, take charge of the pilgrims. Reaching the Universal Father is the passport into eternity. When a material being who started at the very lowest place has climbed step by step and world by world and at last reaches God, the Havona broadcasts announce this joyful news to the whole universe: a being who was born with an animal nature has truly become a perfected son of God.
p26.026: The counselors and advisers of the second circuit teach the pilgrims to prepare for the eternal career. They also comfort the pilgrims who failed on their first attempt. Those pilgrims have suffered a great disappointment, but that disappointment differs only in size from the countless experiences that have lifted them up step by step until now. They gladly go back out to serve, and later they come back and try again.
p26.027: Here the pilgrims who have succeeded sometimes even miss the long struggles of the past. It is a little like an older person looking back on the hardships of youth and wishing to live them over again. Now they get ready for the last great rest.
p26.029: On the innermost, first circuit, the pilgrims mix with the many beings they will soon meet on Paradise and learn how to live together with them. The complements of rest help different beings understand one another and become friends. This paper says it is a mistake to think of God as being like a human because we see his mercy toward the weak. Rather, when a person shows mercy and tolerance, that is proof that the spirit of God is living within him.
p26.030: At last the pilgrim falls asleep in Havona and wakes on the shores of Paradise. We will not fall asleep alone then. A complement of rest, a longtime companion, will be by our side. The first change was death, the second was sleep, and the third is true rest. Knowing that such rest and companionship are waiting at the end of the long journey gives us the strength to bear today's hard work with joy.
p27.002: The primary supernaphim are the highest angels, who serve the Deities on the eternal Isle of Paradise. Since eternity, not a single one of them has ever turned away from the path of light and righteousness. They are also given the task of directing the angels of worlds that were isolated by rebellion once those worlds are restored. The present “⟦Q 27:0.2⟧chief of seraphim⟦/Q⟧” on Urantia (our earth) is the second supernaphim to hold this post since Christ Michael came to this world.
p27.003: The primary supernaphim work in seven groups: the conductors of worship, the masters of philosophy, the custodians of knowledge, the directors of conduct, the interpreters of ethics, the chiefs of assignment, and the instigators of rest. A pilgrim who arrives on Paradise goes through them in reverse order, starting with the instigators of rest and finishing training with the conductors of worship. Then he is ready to begin the life of a finaliter, serving forever.
p27.005: Divine rest is something we truly need in order to enjoy Paradise. The instigators of rest are the angels who put the pilgrim into the last sleep on the innermost circuit of Havona and who greet him again when he wakes on Paradise. There are many kinds of rest: sleep and play, the joy of discovery, worship, rest that renews energy, sleep during travel, and the deep sleep of change when passing from one stage to another.
p27.006: The last transition sleep changes a being of time and space into an inhabitant of Paradise, where there is neither time nor space. When we fall into that sleep, we will remember once again how we placed ourselves in the Father's hands by faith. And we will wake to life everlasting. Then “⟦Q 27:1.5⟧there shall be no more death, neither sorrow nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain⟦/Q⟧”.
p27.008: The chiefs of assignment are the group that leads the organization of all the supernaphim. The supernaphim govern themselves, but the first angel of Paradise is always their joint chief. On Paradise, service matters as well as study, and the chiefs of assignment help with this work. On Paradise we will get to know citizens of more than three thousand orders, and after being among such high beings, talking with angels is a great rest. That is because they remind us of the seraphim who were with us for so long.
p27.010: The higher we rise, the more important ethics become. This paper explains that ethics means recognizing the rights that every being has. While coming up, the pilgrims learned one more set of ethics each time they met a new group of friends. So by the time they reach Paradise, they need interpreters of ethics to help them apply all of it rightly.
p27.011: Meetings like these are always good for both sides. While we learn from countless beings, we also pass on to them something that comes from our experience and personality. So they too are forever made better by their friendship with people who have come up from the evolutionary worlds.
p27.013: The directors of conduct teach the new inhabitants of Paradise the right ways of behaving there. The courtesy of Paradise is not empty ceremony or rank; it comes from the heart. Harmony is the foundation of the central universe, and right conduct is necessary for moving on through knowledge and philosophy to worship. All conduct there is free and natural, but there is still a most proper and perfect way of doing things. Even after long preparation, Paradise is still amazingly new, so the directors of conduct stay beside the “⟦Q 27:4.3⟧strangers within the gates⟦/Q⟧” to help them feel at ease without confusion.
p27.015: The custodians of knowledge are living books and libraries. The facts of the universe are recorded just as they are within these angels, and no falsehood can find a place in their minds. On Paradise, if you want to know something, you do not need to turn the pages of a book; you can call the very angel who holds that knowledge and learn face to face.
p27.016: This knowledge was gathered starting from the recording angels of the planets and passing through recorders all over the universe. The wisdom of truth comes from the divinity of the central universe, but most of the knowledge gained by experience begins in the worlds of time and space. The custodians of knowledge have arranged all this knowledge into seven main divisions.
p27.018: After worship, the next greatest joy is philosophy. However high we rise, there are always a thousand mysteries left to be worked out by philosophy. The masters of philosophy are the “⟦Q 27:6.2⟧wise men of heaven⟦/Q⟧”, and they lead the inhabitants of Paradise in exploring the problems of the universe. With them, knowledge reaches truth and experience rises to wisdom.
p27.019: Their way of teaching is so excellent that one hour of learning on Paradise is said to equal ten thousand years of learning our way. Philosophy cannot be settled the way facts can, but when we listen to them we feel deep satisfaction even about the questions that have not yet been answered.
p27.021: Worship is the highest privilege and the first duty of every being. Worship means knowing, and gladly admitting, that we are in a close relationship with our Creator. The more deeply we know God, the deeper our worship becomes. The whole Isle of Paradise is like one huge sanctuary, and those who have come up there are so overflowing with the wish to worship that the conductors of worship have to guide how they express it.
p27.022: This paper says that just as play rests minds that are tired on earth, worship renews perfected souls on Paradise. The worship of beings who have struggled up out of darkness is so fervent that beings who were perfect from the start cannot fully understand it, and it brings the greatest joy to the Gods. The worship of Paradise is beyond our understanding, but its spirit can be recognized even here and now, because the spirit of God already lives within us.
p27.023: Only after finding full satisfaction in worship does the pilgrim join the Corps of the Finality and begin eternal service. On our journey there are seven great jubilees, such as the agreement with our Thought Adjuster (the spirit of God within us), waking into morontia life, and finding God. The small thanks and worship we give today can be the first step on that long road.
p28.002: If the supernaphim are the angels of the central universe and the seraphim are the angels of the local universes, then the seconaphim are the angels of the superuniverses (huge groups of universes that bind many local universes together). This paper introduces three orders of ministering spirits who work in the superuniverses: the seconaphim, the tertiaphim, and the omniaphim. The tertiaphim and omniaphim have little direct connection with human ascension, so they are covered briefly first, and then the seconaphim are looked at in detail.
p28.004: The tertiaphim are a gift from the Infinite Spirit to a Creator Son. When a Creator Son of the order of Michael sets out to build a new universe, the Infinite Spirit makes one thousand tertiaphim and sends them along with him. In the early days of building the universe, they work as the Creator Son's only staff and gain an enormous amount of experience. When the first Son of that universe is born and the native angels appear, they take on the work of keeping in touch between the Creator Son and the rulers of the superuniverse.
p28.006: The omniaphim are beings made by the Infinite Spirit together with the Seven Supreme Executives, and they are servants and messengers who serve only those Supreme Executives. They watch over and co-ordinate the whole superuniverse, and they have no direct part in the plan for human ascension.
p28.008: The seconaphim are born seven at a time from the Seven Reflective Spirits at the superuniverse headquarters. One becomes a primary, three become secondary, and three become tertiary seconaphim. Their greatest feature is reflectivity, the power to mirror things like a looking glass. This paper says that even without any other evidence, this power of the seconaphim alone would be enough to show that the cosmic mind of the Infinite Spirit really exists.
p28.010: The primary seconaphim are living mirrors for the Ancients of Days, who rule the superuniverse. Imagine standing in front of a mirror and instantly seeing and hearing the response of a being a thousand or a hundred thousand light-years away. Through these mirrors, the Ancients of Days can see and know Paradise above and the inhabited worlds below at the same time.
p28.011: The primary seconaphim serve in seven ways: as the voice that carries the mind of the Infinite Spirit, the voice of the Seven Master Spirits, the voice of the Creator Sons, the voice of the angelic hosts, broadcast receivers, transport personalities who carry pilgrims to Havona, and the reserve corps. For example, if one wants to know what Michael, the Creator of our universe, is thinking, there is no need to call him from far away; his thoughts can be heard right away through that mirror angel. In all the history of Uversa, these voices have never once been wrong.
p28.013: The secondary seconaphim help the wise administrators of the superuniverse. The Voices of Wisdom choose and reflect the best of all the wisdom in the universe. As it is said, “⟦Q 28:5.8⟧If any man lack wisdom, let him ask.⟦/Q⟧” So when hard decisions must be made, they bring together the divine wisdom from above and the practical wisdom from below. The Souls of Philosophy pass on the philosophy of Paradise in a way that fits the lower worlds, and the Unions of Souls reflect the ideals that make relationships between beings better.
p28.014: This paper says that one of the most important lessons to learn during our lives is how to work together. Almost nothing in the universe is done alone. The Hearts of Counsel gather the advice of the finest minds in the universe, and the Joys of Existence show that there is joy in simply being free and alive, and they also help grow a sense of humor. The Satisfactions of Service raise the value of service to others and encourage healthy competition.
p28.015: The Discerners of Spirits unfailingly reflect the true motives and character of any being. That is why the Universal Censors can always judge fairly. But even they cannot read the mind of the Thought Adjuster (a fragment of the spirit of God) who lives within us.
p28.017: The tertiary seconaphim help ascending beings in seven forms. The Significance of Origin shows how each being came into existence, and the Memory of Mercy keeps a living record of the mercy we have received. God's mercy is plentiful for everyone who sincerely wants to live, but it is not forced on those who despise it. This paper says that true mercy does not come all at once. Only after we first become just, fair, patient, and kind can we be truly merciful.
p28.018: The Import of Time teaches that time is the “⟦Q 28:6.9⟧one talent⟦/Q⟧” given to every being. Not using time well does not bring punishment, but it slows down the journey, and both work and rest are important ways of using time. The Solemnity of Trust is a living scale that weighs exactly how trustworthy someone is. Giving great responsibility too early easily leads to failure, so responsibility is given as character grows. The Sanctity of Service reveals the true motive for serving. This paper points to the words “⟦Q 28:6.18⟧It is more blessed to give than to receive⟦/Q⟧” and reminds us that this universe was not made just for me.
p28.019: Last, the Secret of Greatness and the Soul of Goodness always work together, because greatness and goodness cannot be separated. True greatness shows in unselfish work for neighbors in need, and in our world it shows above all in self-control, as in “⟦Q 28:6.20⟧he who subdues his own tongue⟦/Q⟧”. To be great means to be like God, and the more good we become, the more great we are becoming.
p28.021: The seconaphim are born at the superuniverse capitals, but they travel and work everywhere, from Paradise to the evolutionary worlds. The tertiary seconaphim especially give the most help to us ascenders. They save us time, find our mistakes, and become living signposts that show the way at the crossroads.
p28.022: Sadly, Urantia is still partly isolated spiritually, so these mirror angels cannot work freely here. Even so, the celestial workers gladly keep on working with the means they have. The way they do their best without complaining, even when conditions are poor, is a good example for us too.
p29.002: Besides beings like the angels who help people, the universe also has beings who handle energy and power. People have known about angels for a long time, but they have known almost nothing about the beings who manage this physical world. Of the three groups that deal with energy, this paper mainly introduces the Universe Power Directors.
p29.003: The Universe Power Directors include the Seven Supreme Power Directors, the Supreme Power Centers, the Master Physical Controllers, and the Morontia Power Supervisors. Before they came into being, the Master Force Organizers of Paradise looked after the energies of space. The Morontia Power Supervisors are beings we will work with on the mansion worlds, where we first stay after death, but they work only in the local universes, so they are covered later.
p29.005: The Seven Supreme Power Directors are the beings who regulate the physical energies of the grand universe. The Seven Master Spirits made them together, and this is the first record of semimaterial children coming from spiritual parents. The seven directors are exactly alike in form and in work, so no one can tell them apart except the Master Spirit each one is paired with. Each pair forms a unique union of physical energy and spiritual energy. They stay near Paradise and yet reach out with their power to the whole universe. All the physical control organizations that come from them are basically the same, so to move to another superuniverse to work, they only need to go back to Paradise and be readjusted. In this way the physical creation is managed everywhere in the same steady way.
p29.007: The Seven Supreme Power Directors, together with the Seven Master Spirits, made the Supreme Power Centers. These power centers are beings with high intelligence and will, and they are like the brain of the universe power system. They are placed level by level in Havona, the superuniverses, the local universes, the constellations, and the systems. In Havona, energy is controlled perfectly, and this perfection is the goal of all the power centers.
p29.008: The power centers at a superuniverse headquarters divide the huge incoming energies into seven circuits and send them out. These flows are rivers of energy with a clear direction, like the Gulf Stream flowing through the middle of the Atlantic Ocean. The power centers of the local universes and the constellations step these energies down, change them, and pass them out to the worlds below, and they also provide the energy channels used for communication and transport between planets. Each system has one power center that sends energy to the inhabited worlds.
p29.010: There are more than ten billion power centers and their associates, and all of them are perfectly connected with the Seven Supreme Power Directors. They take no orders from any court or universe government. They were also made perfect from the start, so they need no training, and they never change the work they are given. A single power center is made up of exactly one million units of control, and unlike the organs in a human body, these units move freely and combine in many ways, like a kaleidoscope. They work mainly on specially built architectural worlds, and they also have a part in spreading light that shines without heat.
p29.011: Having no past to look back on, they do not play; they are always on duty. That is because the universe plan has no provision for the flow of energy to stop even for a moment. They do not create energy, but they change it, handle it, and give it direction. Yet they fully control only seven of the ten forms of each energy current, and the rest seem to belong to the realm of a greater cosmic force, the Unqualified Absolute.
p29.013: The Master Physical Controllers are beings who act like the hands and feet of the power centers, and they travel through space very fast. They include the associate power directors, the mechanical controllers, the energy transformers, the energy transmitters, the primary associators, the secondary dissociators, and the frandalanks. All of them have intelligence, but the last four especially do not choose for themselves; they respond like machines. This paper explains that having mind does not necessarily mean having personality.
p29.014: The associate power directors are in charge of sending controllers to where they are needed, and the mechanical controllers, the most powerful of the controllers, help angelic transport carriers take off when they leave the earth. There are ten of them on Urantia right now. The energy transformers gather or release energy like living switches, and they protect a planet from strong energy currents. But they do not change the forms of living things.
p29.015: The energy transmitters are like living wires that revive weakened signals and carry sounds and images to faraway places. The primary associators store energy, much as plants store sunlight, and give it out when it is needed, and the secondary dissociators are the “⟦Q 29:4.35⟧alchemists of space⟦/Q⟧”, who produce new energy so that it never runs out. The frandalanks are the most numerous, and they are living gauges that measure the condition of energy exactly. The frandalanks that also measure time are called chronoldeks.
p29.017: The Master Force Organizers live on Paradise and work especially in the far outer space that has not yet been organized. They are special beings who are neither creators nor creatures. The primary force organizers set the very first force of space in motion and stir up huge whirls of energy, that is, nebulae, and the associate force organizers take over that work and change the energy one stage further.
p29.018: When a plan is made to create a new local universe and a Creator Son arrives, the force organizers hand that region over to the power directors. They work even at enormous temperatures that other beings could not bear. When we learn that behind the light and energy we enjoy every day there are countless beings working without rest like this, even an ordinary day feels like something to be thankful for all over again.
p30.002: Countless beings live on Paradise and in the grand universe. Just counting the major orders and kinds is enough to make the human imagination spin. This paper sums them up in two ways: by the Paradise classification and by the personality register of Uversa, the capital of our superuniverse.
p30.003: But since not all beings have been revealed, a complete classification cannot be made. This paper says that this is actually a good thing. Revealing too much all at once would take away from thinking people of the next thousand years the joy of working things out for themselves. As it says, “⟦Q 30:0.2⟧It is best that man not have an overrevelation; it stifles imagination.⟦/Q⟧”
p30.004: 1. The Paradise Classification of Living Beings
p30.005: On Paradise, beings are divided according to where they came from. There are triune-origin beings, who come from all three Deities or from the Trinity; dual-origin beings, who come from two; and single-origin beings, who come from one. For example, the Creator Son of our universe and the Melchizedeks are dual-origin beings, and angels like the Solitary Messengers and the seraphim, whom we saw in earlier papers, are single-origin beings who come from the Infinite Spirit alone. Humans who have become one with their Thought Adjusters also belong to the ascending orders among the dual-origin beings.
p30.006: Besides these, there are the Transcendentalers, who are neither creators nor creatures; fragments of Deity that have come out from God, like the Thought Adjusters; superpersonal beings who have no personality; and many orders that are not yet known. This paper says that no being can have personality unless God, who is spirit, gives it. It also admits that because we are individuals, we can explain beings who have personality, but beings far higher than that are hard to explain.
p30.008: On Uversa, beings are registered in seven large groups: the Paradise Deities, the Supreme Spirits, the Trinity-origin beings, the Sons of God, the personalities of the Infinite Spirit, the Universe Power Directors, and the Corps of Permanent Citizenship. The Sons of God include both Sons who come down from above to serve and Sons like us who climb up from below. This classification is mainly meant to tell us about the beings we will meet as we rise to Paradise. The Corps of Permanent Citizenship includes beings who stay in one place and live as its citizens, such as the planetary midwayers, the Adamic Sons of the systems, the Havona natives, and the Paradise Citizens.
p30.009: On top of these, there are groups made up of many kinds of beings together: the Corps of the Finality, which those who have finished the ascension join; the universe aids, who help the Creator Sons; and the seven courtesy colonies, which stay on the various headquarters worlds. A superuniverse capital is a place where almost every kind of being meets.
p30.011: The courtesy colonies are groups of guests who stay on the headquarters worlds for special purposes. The star students, the astronomers of heaven, study every corner of the universe from Uversa, which is well suited for observation. Outside Paradise, knowledge is not given automatically, so understanding of the universe has to be gained through observation and study. Anyone can become a star student as long as he has enough knowledge of life and of the physical laws of the universe. There are also the celestial artisans, the reversion directors, who help with rest and humor, and various reserve corps.
p30.012: The extension school instructors come down from the world one stage higher to teach the students of the world below. A feature of the ascension plan is that we share newly learned truth and experience with others right away, and we move forward by teaching those who come right behind us. Countless student visitors and ascending pilgrims stay there as well. Right now there are more than a billion visitors on Uversa alone; some stay for a day, and some stay for a year. This paper says that our wish to travel and see new worlds and people will be completely fulfilled on the road to Paradise.
p30.014: This paper shows the seven stages of ascension that people like us will walk through. The first is the mortal who lives on a planet. Second, those who have no personal guardian angel sleep without consciousness after death until a new age comes, and even if they sleep five thousand years, it feels like five days. Third, they become students who wake up on the mansion worlds. At that point the old body returns to the dust, and what the Thought Adjuster and the guardian angel have kept comes together again, and they are resurrected in a new morontia body. These training worlds are the very places Jesus meant when he said, “⟦Q 30:4.17⟧In my Father's house are many mansions.⟦/Q⟧” The races people are born into differ from world to world, but all receive the same care, and after death they mix together like one family on the mansion worlds. Within one world each person moves ahead on his own, but when crossing the big stages of study, they always rise together as a class.
p30.015: Fourth, as morontia progressors, they climb in turn through the worlds of the system, the constellation, and the local universe. Before leaving the local universe they become true spirits, and from then on our status is fixed forever. Fifth, as wards of the superuniverse, they learn how to run a universe. Sixth, they go alone to Havona and receive spiritual education fitted to each person. When they arrive, they first thank the angel who brought them and send a message of thanks to the Creator Son.
p30.016: Seventh, when they reach Paradise, they have found God, and they enter the Mortal Corps of the Finality. Finaliters are serving even now on worlds that have reached light and life. This long road by which beings of animal origin come to God shows God's wisdom and love. The fact that the life we live today is the first stage of that great journey gives us a reason to live each day as something precious.
p31.002: The Mortal Corps of the Finality is where people who have become one with their Thought Adjusters (the spirit of God within us) arrive at the end of their long ascension. Six groups join this corps together: the Havona natives, the Gravity Messengers, glorified mortals, adopted seraphim, glorified Material Sons, and glorified midway creatures. Right now the finaliters are serving on worlds that have reached light and life, but it is thought that their future destination will be the universes of outer space that are being made now.
p31.003: Every being who joins the corps is equal, but that does not mean each one's individuality disappears. The finaliters serve in one superuniverse after another, and only after going through all six of the other superuniverses do they go to their home superuniverse. Even now, more than one company of finaliters is working on Urantia. They choose their own leaders, and they pledge loyalty only to the Paradise Trinity. They are “⟦Q 31:0.13⟧the evolutionary salt of the universe⟦/Q⟧”, tested in time and space, and they will never give in to evil.
p31.005: Many of the natives who taught pilgrims in Havona (the perfect central universe) come to care so much for ascending humans that they want to join the Corps of the Finality. Right now millions upon millions are on the waiting list. Because beings who were perfect from birth are part of it, the Corps of the Finality has both the point of view of perfect beings and that of perfected beings. A company of finaliters is made up of a thousand members: one Havona native, one Gravity Messenger, and 997 ascended beings.
p31.007: The Gravity Messengers are mysterious messengers who leap across time and space and come and go in an instant. They are Adjusters who have been changed in form and personalized, and they are under the command of the finaliters. The finaliters cannot overcome time and space by themselves, but they work with these messengers. A Gravity Messenger is a fragment of the Father's spirit that has become a person directly, and a finaliter is a human who has become one with such a fragment, so the two feel a deep affection for each other.
p31.009: Most of the Corps of the Finality are ascended humans. Together with the adopted seraphim, they make up 990 of each company. But even the beings on Uversa do not know exactly what this very long training is for. Humans climb the stages of spirit one by one as they ascend, and when they take the finaliter oath they reach the sixth stage. So in a way, a seventh stage is still left.
p31.010: The finaliters have obeyed the command “⟦Q 31:3.6⟧Be you perfect⟦/Q⟧” and have found God, but they have not reached the final stage of service and Deity attainment. Climbing from the lowest worlds to Paradise, they have thoroughly learned the principles of ruling the universe with justice and mercy. This paper invites us to wonder about it together: “⟦Q 31:3.8⟧Why should the Gods be so concerned in so thoroughly training surviving mortals in the technique of universe management?⟦/Q⟧”
p31.012: Many guardian angels (seraphim) walk the path of ascension together with the people they cared for. Then, after that person becomes one with the Adjuster, they take the finaliter oath together and share the human destiny forever. That the angel who stayed by our side all through life remains our companion to the very end is a truly warm story.
p31.014: The Material Sons, the Adams and Eves sent to the planets, can also become finaliters. Some who have long been waiting for assignments ask for it, and some choose it themselves in the later times of the age of light and life and walk the path of ascension. Those who partly failed in their missions, like the Adam of Urantia, usually have to receive an Adjuster like ordinary people, go through death, and rise by faith. Not many companies have them, but when they do, they are always chosen as leaders.
p31.016: The midway creatures are beings between humans and angels. When their home world reaches light and life, they leave it and rise with humans through the morontia worlds, the superuniverse, and Havona to Paradise. In the end they all join one of the corps of finaliters too.
p31.018: Right now every company of finaliters has 999 sworn members, and one place is empty. That place is filled by the chief of the evangels of light, who works with them for a time. The evangels of light are various celestial beings assigned to help the Corps of the Finality; they do not take the oath, and when their task is finished they go back to their own places. No one knows who will fill that empty place forever in the future. Whether it will be some being born in a new universe or some Paradise personality not yet brought into being, we will likely know only after the finaliters reach the seventh stage.
p31.020: On Paradise live special beings called Transcendentalers. They have not created anyone, and no one created them; it is said that they “⟦Q 31:8.3⟧simply eventuate⟦/Q⟧”. They have nothing to do with the affairs of Havona or the superuniverses and are concerned only with the affairs of the greater master universe. On Paradise the finaliters try hard to understand these beings and become friends with them like brothers. The first time a human meets a Transcendentaler in a serious way is the moment of the finaliter oath, when the chief of the Transcendentalers administers that oath.
p31.022: The Architects of the Master Universe are 28,011 beings who rule over the Transcendentalers. They are divided into seven levels and plan and co-ordinate Paradise, Havona, the seven superuniverses, and the four universes of outer space that are still being made. The farther out they go, the more their number grows, seven times over. Their origin, nature, and destiny have not been fully revealed.
p31.023: The Architects approve the places where Creator Sons will build their local universes, and they work very closely with the Creator Sons. They have many helpers, such as the primary force organizers and the associate force organizers. The children trinitized together by finaliters and Paradise Citizens are also under the care of these Architects.
p31.025: There are seven Corps of the Finality in all, and Grandfanda, the first ascender, is the chief of all the finaliters. The gathering of these seven corps seems to be preparation for the huge new universes that will appear in far outer space. In those outer universes, which can already be seen through telescopes, there are at least seventy thousand masses of matter, each larger than a present superuniverse.
p31.026: The beings who live in those future universes will not have the chance to take part in the growth of God the Supreme. Right now we are growing in him, and he is growing in us. This paper says that we will treasure forever this special experience that can be had only in the youth of the universe. So the finaliters who carry this experience may someday rule the outer universes and make up for what they lack.
p31.027: Born on a planet as a life of animal origin, passing through the morontia worlds and the spirit universes, crossing Havona, and finding God on Paradise: this is the road. The paper ends with this cry: “⟦Q 31:10.20⟧What a glorious destiny⟦/Q⟧”! This very destiny is open to each one of us, living an ordinary day right now.
p32.002: The local universe we live in is the work of a Creator Son called Michael, a Son of God who came from Paradise. A local universe is made up of one hundred constellations, each constellation has one hundred systems, and each system will in the end hold about a thousand inhabited worlds. None of these universes were finished from the start; they are evolutionary universes that grow and develop little by little. Urantia, our earth, belongs to the local universe called Nebadon, and its sovereign is Michael of Salvington, who came to this world as Jesus of Nazareth. All of Michael's plans received the full approval of the Paradise Trinity before he began his work.
p32.004: Before a local universe comes into being, space holds only force and energy that have not yet become matter. First the force organizers of Paradise work with this energy, and when the energy has gathered enough to respond to gravity, the power directors of the superuniverse take over the work. Only when the power directors have gathered enough energy to become suns and planets can the Creator Son begin to organize a universe.
p32.005: Local universes have roughly the same amount of energy, but they differ greatly in size. When enough matter has gathered, the Creator Son appears together with a Creative Daughter of the Infinite Spirit, and the building of the headquarters world that will be the capital of the universe begins. Over long ages, while the suns settle into place and the planets move into their orbits, the headquarters worlds of the constellations and systems are made one after another.
p32.007: The first thing finished in Nebadon was Salvington, the capital of the universe, together with its satellites. From the time energy was first set in motion until workers arrived on Salvington took a little over a billion years of our time. Next, one hundred constellation headquarters worlds and ten thousand system headquarters worlds were made. These architectural worlds were designed so that not only material beings and spirit beings but also morontia beings could live there. Morontia beings are in the stage between the two, the in-between beings that humans become as they grow toward spirit after death.
p32.008: Once the physical framework of the universe is in place, the Creator Son and the Creative Spirit make plans to create life. The first result is the Bright and Morning Star, the chief executive, who is like the Creator Son's right arm. Then countless sons and daughters come into being, and a government is set up, from the universe councils to the Constellation Fathers, the System Sovereigns, and the Planetary Princes. When all these preparations are finished, the Creator Son takes part in making mortal humans in the image of God.
p32.009: Nebadon is still a young universe, so worlds are still being organized even now. At the last record, Nebadon had 3,840,101 inhabited planets. The system of Satania, which our earth belongs to, has 619 inhabited worlds, scattered among more than five hundred different groups of stars. Satania is on the outskirts of the local universe, and Nebadon too lies off toward the edge of the superuniverse of Orvonton.
p32.011: The only place made perfect from the start is the central universe, Havona, the perfect universe around Paradise. All the other universes become perfect as they grow little by little. A local universe is organized on the pattern of the central universe, but one thing is different. In the central universe the Father is present in person, but he does not live within the minds of the beings there. In our universe, on the other hand, the Father is not present in person, and the Creator Son stands in his place, but within the human mind the spirit of God, the Mystery Monitor or Thought Adjuster, lives close by.
p32.012: The farther down the ladder of life we go, the harder it becomes to find the invisible Father by faith. So it is easy to waver or fall into doubt, and the surest safeguard is to hold tight to the truth that the Father is present in his Sons. As the text says, “⟦Q 32:3.6⟧He who has seen a Creator Son has seen the Father.⟦/Q⟧”
p32.013: An origin that evolved up from animals is nothing to be ashamed of. Instead, those who start at the very bottom and gladly climb up one step at a time gain greater honor, because they come to know every stage of life by going through it themselves. God could have made us perfect from the beginning, but doing so would have taken away the adventure of growing through our own effort. Beings who were perfect from the start and beings who became perfect through effort are simply different kinds; they need each other, and together they move toward higher goals.
p32.014: 4. God’s Relation to a Local Universe
p32.015: The Universal Father hands over much of his work to his Sons and other beings, but he is not one who does nothing. He simply does not do himself what someone else can do, while he truly takes part through all those channels. In ruling a local universe, the laws of the Creator Son and the decisions of the rulers under him always come first, and among the Gods there is perfect oneness of mind without any conflict.
p32.016: At the same time, the Father is directly connected with each one of us in two ways. One is the Thought Adjuster who lives within our minds, and the other is the personality circuit. Through the personality circuit, the Father personally knows every thought and act of every being. So we can be strengthened in the assurance that the “⟦Q 32:4.8⟧Lord knows his children⟦/Q⟧”.
p32.017: God is not one who thinks only of himself. The Father has gladly given away everything that other beings can do, and from what is left, he has given us the Thought Adjuster as a gift. God has given himself to us so that we can become like him. Here we see the Father's endless love and generosity.
p32.019: There is a great and glorious purpose in the way the universes move through space. None of our efforts are wasted, and we are all part of a vast plan too big to take in at a glance. The things we go through in this world are like temporary scaffolding for crossing over into the spiritual world. Everything we are used to has an end, so it is very hard to understand eternity, which has no beginning and no end.
p32.020: The messenger who wrote this paper suggests that we think of eternity not as a straight road but as a huge circle that goes around without end. A person's life or an age may seem to appear for a while and then vanish, but it goes on again in a new form in a higher life. In the mind of God there is a plan that embraces every creature, a plan of endless opportunity, progress, and life.
p32.021: The text cries out, “⟦Q 32:5.8⟧The race for perfection is on!⟦/Q⟧” Anyone who wants to can enter this race, and victory is promised to everyone who runs it by faith, following the leading of the Adjuster within. It would be good to remember that even the small effort I am making now is a precious step in the eternal plan.
p33.002: The Universal Father rules all of creation, but he rules our local universe through a Creator Son. The plans, policies, and administration of a local universe are in the hands of the Creator Son, the local universe Mother Spirit, and their children. The Creator Son entrusts executive power to Gabriel and gives each Constellation Father, System Sovereign, and Planetary Prince his own authority to rule. This paper shows how our universe, Nebadon, is governed.
p33.004: Our Creator Son, Michael, is the 611,121st original concept, coming at the same time from the Universal Father and the Eternal Son, that has become a person. His home on Salvington is a threefold mansion of light, because Michael has lived spiritual, morontia, and material lives. Morontia means the stage between the material and the spiritual. Since his seventh and final bestowal on Urantia, he has also been called Christ Michael.
p33.005: Michael is not the same as the Eternal Son of the Paradise Trinity. But within Nebadon he holds every power the Eternal Son would have, and beyond that he even represents the Universal Father. So to our universe and the worlds in it, Michael is in practice like God in every way. This Son and his Spirit companion are our creator parents.
p33.007: Among the Creator Sons, some are more like the Father and some are more like the Eternal Son, and Michael is more like the Eternal Son. Michael rules Nebadon supremely, but the gravity circuits centered on Paradise, and the final verdict that ends a personality, are left to the Ancients of Days of the superuniverse. Only the Father gives personality.
p33.008: When he came back after finishing his final bestowal on Urantia, the Creative Mother Spirit placed herself under Michael of her own will, and Michael gained “⟦Q 33:2.3⟧all power in heaven and on earth⟦/Q⟧”. Michael has his headquarters on Salvington, but he often visits the constellations, systems, and planets, and he also goes to Paradise and to Uversa, the superuniverse capital. When he is away, Gabriel becomes the regent, the one who rules in his place.
p33.010: The Universe Mother Spirit of Salvington is the Infinite Spirit as she appears in this universe. When Michael left Paradise, she volunteered to go with him, and ever since, she has made and ruled the universe together with him. The Son works like a father, and the Spirit works like a mother. The Spirit accepts the Son as sovereign, and the Son gives the Spirit the same status and authority as himself in all things. When a rebellion breaks out, only the Son can step forward as the deliverer, but without the help of the Spirit and her countless angels, no Son could ever finally succeed.
p33.011: On the day Michael finished his final bestowal and became a Master Son, the Universe Spirit, before everyone, pledged her loyalty to the Son for the first time. Then Michael made the Spirit his coruler and announced to the whole universe the “⟦Q 33:3.6⟧Proclamation of Equality⟦/Q⟧”, declaring that the Spirit is equal to him in personality and character. This becomes the high ideal for the human institutions of family and marriage. Now the Son and the Spirit care for the whole universe the way a father and mother care for their children.
p33.013: The first being that the Creator Son and the Mother Spirit made together is the Bright and Morning Star. Only one Morning Star is born in a local universe, and the Morning Star of Nebadon is Gabriel of Salvington. Gabriel carries both the will of the Son and the creative imagination of the Spirit, and he deeply understands both angels and material humans. He is not a creator, but he is an outstanding administrator, so the Son and the Spirit do not discuss important matters without Gabriel.
p33.014: Gabriel is the chief executive of Nebadon and the commander in chief of “⟦Q 33:4.6⟧the armies of heaven⟦/Q⟧”. He and his staff are not teachers; they are rulers. Gabriel has been deeply connected with the history of Urantia ever since Michael came to this world. Humans do not meet Gabriel often while they are rising, but when they are given administrative work, they will work under his direction.
p33.016: A local universe is ruled together by a fatherly Creator Son and a motherly Creative Spirit. Even so, a few personalities from Paradise stay here and give help. The chief of these is Immanuel of Salvington, the ambassador of the Paradise Trinity. He is like the representative of the Universal Father sent to the court of the Creator Son, and so he bears the name Immanuel.
p33.017: Immanuel has great majesty and yet is very humble, and he accepts no one's worship. He is the only personality in Nebadon who does not belong to Michael, and he gives advice only when asked. Each constellation also has ambassadors called the Faithfuls of Days, and they too help only when they are asked.
p33.019: The one who actually runs the universe is Gabriel, and his first assistant is the Father Melchizedek. The work of ruling is divided by level. The system governments mostly care for the physical and biological problems of the beings who live on the planets, the constellation governments care for the unity and stability of society and government, and the universe rulers care more for the spiritual condition of the worlds.
p33.020: On Salvington, broadcasts go out at the same time to the constellations, the systems, and each planet, and they reach every inhabited world except those that are spiritually isolated. Time is fixed too: a Nebadon day is about eighteen days of our time, a Nebadon year is about five years, and a Satania day is a little shorter than three days of our time.
p33.022: Michael devotes himself only to creating, sustaining, and ministering, and he does not take part in judging himself. As the text says, “⟦Q 33:7.1⟧Creators never sit in judgment on their creatures⟦/Q⟧”. Judging is done by those who have real creature experience, and every case is handled together by one perfect judge and one judge who has had the experience of ascension.
p33.023: But questions of eternal life and death, cases in which a Son of God has done wrong, and the question of taking an isolated system back in are decided by the superuniverse. In all other matters, the courts of Salvington give the final decision. Even when disputes on earth seem to end unfairly, in the universe justice wins, and we can trust that we will be dealt with justly and mercifully.
p33.025: Salvington has no body that makes laws. Laws are made by the legislative assemblies at the hundred constellation headquarters, and the systems carry those laws out. Salvington has many advisory councils, and the highest of them, the supreme council, is made up of three representatives from each system and seven from each constellation. These councils give good advice, but they do not make or carry out laws themselves.
p33.026: The words ‘court’ and ‘council’ used here point to spiritual work that is very different from the material institutions of this world. The fact that a vast universe is ruled in such an orderly way, with everyone helping one another and sharing the work, tells us that our lives too can become more beautiful through order and co-operation.
p34.002: When a Creator Son is born, the Infinite Spirit also brings forth a new and separate presence of himself that will go out into space with him. This Creative Spirit becomes the Creator Son's partner, first in making the material universe and later in making and caring for the life there. In material creation, the Son provides the plans, and the Spirit turns energy into actual matter according to those plans. This paper is about this Spirit, who is like a mother to our universe.
p34.004: When the stars and planets of a universe are all in place, Michael announces that he will now send life into this universe. When Paradise approves, the Master Spirit in charge of that superuniverse disappears for a while into the light of the Deities and then appears again, and a great spiritual flash that can be seen from far away, a “⟦Q 34:1.1⟧primary eruption⟦/Q⟧”, takes place. At that very moment, before the Creator Son, a new personality of the Infinite Spirit is born, the Divine Minister. She is the local universe Mother Spirit.
p34.005: Until then, the Creative Spirit was closer to a power that helped the Son than to a clear personality. How this amazing change happens is a secret known only to the Paradise Trinity. The Mother Spirit, now a person, comes to resemble the nature of the Master Spirit of the superuniverse, and later she became able to place herself under the Creator Son of her own will.
p34.007: The Divine Minister works very personally with the Creator Son, planning and caring for the affairs of the universe. Since Michael finished his last bestowal and became a Master Son, her personality has become even clearer, so that every being who meets her can recognize her as a person. She has not only the power to handle matter but also the power to draw and direct all the minds of the universe.
p34.008: The Creative Spirit makes life together with the Son and guards it to the end. First they make the Bright and Morning Star together, and then they make orders that come closer and closer to the beings of the planets. When the Life Carriers make a body out of matter, the Universe Spirit gives that body the “⟦Q 34:2.5⟧breath of life⟦/Q⟧”. Our superuniverse, Orvonton, is slow in its development, but because its Master Spirit carries the natures of all three Deities evenly, it is hoped that it will become a very well-balanced creation.
p34.009: 3. The Son and Spirit in Time and Space
p34.010: The Infinite Spirit and the Eternal Son are not bound by time and space, but most of their offspring are. The Creative Spirit is not bound by space, so she is spread evenly through the whole universe and is present in the same way on every world, but she has to take time into account. The Creator Son, on the other hand, is not bound by time, but he cannot be in two places at once, so he is limited by space.
p34.011: So when the two work together, each makes up for the other's limits. Within their own local universe, by joining their powers, they can work freely in both time and space. The only beings fully free from time and space are the absolute beings.
p34.013: There are three streams of spirit in Nebadon: the Spirit of Truth sent by the Creator Son, the Holy Spirit of the Mother Spirit, and the ministry of the seven adjutant mind-spirits. The Spirit of Truth is the spirit a bestowal Son pours out on a world, and it leads everyone who seeks truth to the Son, who is truth itself. The Mother Spirit never leaves Salvington, and she is the center where the Holy Spirit and the Spirit of Truth come together.
p34.014: The seven adjutant mind-spirits were made by the Mother Spirit, and they help the minds of living things. Their names are the spirits of intuition, understanding, courage, knowledge, counsel, worship, and wisdom. Also, the four creature controllers of Salvington are like living compasses that set the directions of the universe. Thanks to them, the body of every living thing has a small organ that senses north and south, so it has a sense of direction.
p34.016: On the inhabited worlds, the Spirit guides evolution, starting with lifeless matter and going on to plants, animals, and the first humans. When an animal mind grows enough to receive the adjutants of worship and wisdom, that mind enters the circuit of the Holy Spirit and becomes ready to receive a Thought Adjuster, the spirit sent by the Universal Father. When a bestowal Son pours out the Spirit of Truth, every normal mind becomes ready to receive an Adjuster.
p34.017: The Spirit of Truth works as much as we accept it, and the Holy Spirit works more effectively the more we co-operate. In this way, the Holy Spirit of the Mother Spirit, the Spirit of Truth of the Son, and the Adjuster of the Father are all present together in one person, helping us realize by faith that we are children of God.
p34.019: The spirit of God comes in many forms, but in our experience it is always one. The divine spirit comes down from on high to meet us just as we are, and it does not stop until it has embraced us by faith and carried us back up to that high place. Spiritual energy, like the strength of the body, wears out when it is used, so we always need the spirit to fill us anew. Even the finest teaching cannot change a person unless the spirit breathes life into it.
p34.020: Within us there are both an animal nature and spiritual longings, and on this earth they do not easily become one. Even so, the spirit helps us bring the body more and more under the spirit's leading. What matters is this: “⟦Q 34:6.11⟧The Spirit never drives, only leads.⟦/Q⟧” If we are willing to learn, the spirit gently leads us.
p34.021: In a person who is led by the spirit, the fruits of the spirit grow: love, joy, peace, long-suffering, kindness, goodness, faith, meekness, and self-control. Such a person lives with a hope that overcomes fear, even in hard times.
p34.023: The nature of our bodies, which came from animals, does not bear the fruits of the spirit on its own. People on normal worlds do not go through a fierce struggle between the spirit and the body; their growth is more like a process of being educated. But Urantia lost the moral support of its society because of the rebellion of Caligastia, and because of Adam's failure it did not receive a bodily nature that responds better to the spirit. So we go through a greater conflict between the spirit and the body.
p34.024: Still, there is hope. Jesus showed a new way of living that rises above these difficulties, and people who know God become free from the bondage of the body in the service of doing the Father's will. The natural desires of the body do not clash with spiritual growth. If we move forward without fearing failure or wavering, at every hard crossroad the Spirit of Truth will speak to us, saying, “⟦Q 34:7.8⟧This is the way.⟦/Q⟧”
p35.002: The Sons of God we met earlier all came from Paradise. In Nebadon there is one Creator Son, Michael; there are 1,062 Avonal Sons, called “⟦Q 35:0.1⟧lesser Christs⟦/Q⟧”; and there are the Trinity Teacher Sons, who are outstanding teachers. In this paper we look at the Sons who are born in the local universe itself, the children of the Creator Son and the Universe Mother Spirit working together: the Melchizedek, Vorondadek, and Lanonandek Sons. The Life Carrier Sons get their own paper next.
p35.004: The first being that the Creator Son and the Creative Spirit brought into existence by joining their powers in a new way is the Father Melchizedek. Later, together with the Son and the Spirit, he helped bring the whole Melchizedek order into being. In Nebadon the Father Melchizedek is Gabriel’s first associate. Gabriel handles the big policies of the universe, while Melchizedek handles the practical work and the emergency commissions. The two of them are never away from Salvington at the same time.
p35.006: The Melchizedek Sons are the first order of divine sons that can help human beings directly without taking on a body. They stand halfway between the highest Deities and the lowliest creatures, so they serve as a bridge between the two. Even the angels love to work with them, and every kind of being thinks of them as understanding friends and wise teachers.
p35.007: The Melchizedeks are a self-governing order, and in all of Orvonton they have never betrayed a trust. Like the oldest children in a big family, they look for work on their own and travel from world to world to settle hard problems. Their wisdom is almost perfect, but now and then they make a small mistake. When that happens, they receive instruction on Salvington and go back to work on the third day. There are more than ten million Melchizedeks in Nebadon.
p35.009: The Melchizedeks live on the Melchizedek worlds near Salvington. Around Salvington there are 70 large spheres and 420 satellites, 490 worlds in all, which are often called the Melchizedek University. Humans who rise from every part of Nebadon pass through all 490 of these worlds for their training.
p35.010: The Melchizedek worlds may well be the most interesting places in Nebadon for ascending mortals. On their satellites, ascenders look back over and sort out everything they have experienced so far: life on their home planet, the mansion worlds, the system, and the constellation. The Melchizedek schools of Nebadon are so famous that more than a hundred thousand students from other universes are always studying there.
p35.012: Besides teaching, the Melchizedeks are also “⟦Q 35:4.2⟧emergency Sons⟦/Q⟧” who take care of every kind of crisis. Wherever special help is needed, a Melchizedek is sure to show up, and sometimes they even take over a planetary government that has failed in its task. Seven times in Nebadon a Melchizedek has been born in human form to serve.
p35.013: One of them was Melchizedek of Salem, who came to Urantia in the days of Abraham. He was worried that the light of truth might go out in the spiritual darkness of the time, so he took on a human body himself. He kept the truth of that age alive and passed it on to Abraham and his companions.
p35.015: The second order of Sons is the Vorondadeks. Because they rule the constellations, they are better known as Constellation Fathers. There are one million of them in Nebadon, and their number does not grow. They are not as many-sided as the Melchizedeks, but as rulers they are more dependable, and their judgment is very steady. Never in the history of Nebadon has a Vorondadek joined a rebellion.
p35.016: The Vorondadeks serve as ambassadors and consuls to other universes. On worlds cut off by rebellion they stay as observers, and when needed they use great authority. And because they know so much about the political and social changes on many worlds, they have become the historians of the local universe.
p35.018: Every constellation is ruled by at least three Vorondadeks working together. The highest is the Constellation Father, and beside him are the senior associate and the junior associate. One term of service lasts about fifty thousand years of Urantia time. The senior associate mostly looks after spiritual matters and the junior associate after physical well-being, but no important policy is carried out unless all three agree. The hundred Constellation Fathers form the Creator Son’s highest advisory cabinet. Our own constellation, Norlatiadek, is now ruled by twelve Vorondadeks.
p35.020: The second group of worlds around Salvington, seven worlds and their satellites, forty-nine worlds in all, belongs to the Vorondadeks. Here ascending mortals learn how laws are made, and they even take part in real lawmaking that coordinates the laws made by the hundred constellations. These worlds hold so many new things we cannot even imagine that, we are told, there is no way to describe them in human words.
p35.022: The third order, the Lanonandeks, is well known as the System Sovereigns, who rule the systems, and the Planetary Princes, who rule the individual planets. Nebadon began with exactly twelve million Lanonandeks, and they were the first students of the Melchizedek University. According to their test results they were sorted into three ranks, primary, secondary, and tertiary, and once a rank is set it never changes.
p35.023: The Lanonandeks have a somewhat lower level of divinity, so they can come closer to creatures like us. For that same reason, they are also at greater risk of going astray. Even so, the primary Lanonandeks in particular are the most capable administrators in the local universe.
p35.025: System Sovereigns rule their systems in groups of two or three, and in the affairs of their system they hold almost sovereign power. That is why this is the position where disloyalty to the Creator Son can most easily take root. In fact, more than seven hundred Lanonandeks in Nebadon have rebelled and caused confusion, and most of them were Planetary Princes.
p35.026: This is not the Creator Son’s fault. These Sons were created with great freedom so that they could understand human beings better. At first this brings trouble, but we are told that the loyalty of the Sons who come through their testing faithfully more than makes up for the difficulty. When a Planetary Prince rebels, his planet is cut off spiritually, and only a bestowal Son can restore the connection. Even for the Sons who went wrong, a way back to restoration is open.
p35.028: The third group of worlds around Salvington is the administrative worlds of the Lanonandeks. Here experienced Lanonandeks who have ruled systems teach ascending mortals and angels how to govern. The training here is hands-on: students practice what they have learned. The Sons who accepted the path of restoration keep serving in work connected with these worlds.
p35.029: Many Lanonandeks have left splendid records of service and spiritual achievement. A being who is given freedom also runs the risk of doing wrong, but when that freedom is used rightly, the brightest loyalty comes from it. May the freedom given to us be used in that same way.
p36.002: Life does not just appear on its own. It is made according to a set plan, and the job of carrying life to inhabited planets belongs to the Life Carriers. They draw up the designs for living things, and after planting life on a new planet they stay for a long time to help it grow well. This paper tells us who these fascinating Sons are and how they work.
p36.003: 1. Origin and Nature of Life Carriers
p36.004: The Life Carriers are special Sons. Three personalities make them together: the Creator Son, the Universe Mother Spirit, and one of the Ancients of Days of the superuniverse. The Ancients of Days, the only beings who can take life away, take part in making the beings who plant life. There are one hundred million Life Carriers in Nebadon, and they are directed by Gabriel, the Father Melchizedek, and the first Life Carrier, Nambia.
p36.005: The Life Carriers are divided into three groups: the senior Life Carriers, the assistants, and the custodians. The Melchizedeks stay close to them, and they always go along when the Life Carriers set out to plant life on a new planet.
p36.007: Around Salvington are the seven worlds of the Life Carriers. The first world is the headquarters where every kind of life is studied. The second is where life is designed, the third is where life is preserved, and the fourth is where the evolution of life is studied. The fifth and sixth worlds study how life relates to mind and how mind relates to spirit. The work of the seventh world has not been revealed.
p36.008: In the world of life, numbers such as 3, 7, and 12 show up in important ways, and the reproductive cells of Urantia people carry forty-eight units that decide their traits. Life is a little different on every planet, because the Life Carriers are always trying to improve the formulas of life. Urantia in particular is a life-experiment world, one of about every ten worlds, so more new variations could be tried here than on an ordinary world.
p36.009: During evolution, animals and plants that seem useless sometimes appear and then disappear. But the wise plan of those who first designed life runs through the whole process, and in the end all of it is needed for higher, intelligent life to appear.
p36.011: Life Carriers usually go to a new planet as a team of one hundred senior Life Carriers, one hundred assistants, and one thousand custodians. In the case of Urantia, after they arrived they built the patterns of life according to the approved formulas. Once those patterns were ready, the spark of life was passed on through the Life Carriers, and lifeless matter became living matter. But the one who supplies the essence of that spark is the Universe Mother Spirit.
p36.012: The Life Carriers can plant life for about five hundred thousand years, and after that they cannot add anything new. Still, until human beings appear, they can shape the environment and help evolution move in good directions. But once beings appear who have wills able to make moral choices, their work is over, because Life Carriers are not allowed to interfere with will. Even now, two senior Life Carriers and twelve custodians remain on Urantia as advisers.
p36.014: Every system in Nebadon has one special world where Melchizedeks served as Life Carriers. It is called the Midsonite world. There a Melchizedek Son who had taken on a material body was paired with a Material Daughter from the system headquarters, and they had children. Their descendants are called Midsonters.
p36.015: The Midsonters live and have children until they are a thousand years old, and after that they are carried to another world by seraphim, that is, angels. They have never gone through death, and every one of them is still alive. What future they are being gathered for has not yet been revealed.
p36.017: On primitive worlds, evolution moves forward by purpose rather than by chance because the seven adjutant mind-spirits are present. They are children of the Universe Mother Spirit, and they are like currents that help the minds of living creatures. Their names are the spirits of intuition, understanding, courage, knowledge, counsel, worship, and wisdom.
p36.018: The spirit of intuition gives quick reflexes and instincts, and the spirit of understanding gives the ability to link ideas together. The spirit of courage is the root of character and moral strength, and the spirit of knowledge gives the curiosity to explore and discover. The spirit of counsel gives the desire to get along and work together with others. The spirit of worship is the religious urge, and it sets human beings apart from animals that have no soul. The highest, the spirit of wisdom, coordinates the work of all the others so that growth happens in an orderly way.
p36.019: The first five spirits also work in animals, so animals were essential to the development of the human body and mind. When a mind becomes able to worship and recognize God, that mind is connected to the spiritual circuits of the Mother Spirit. A mind that has no spiritual insight and no capacity to worship does not survive forever.
p36.021: Life is both material and spiritual. Even if scientists come to understand the structure of living things more and more deeply, they will never be able to create a living being themselves. That is because life comes only from life, mind from mind, and spirit from spirit. The Life Carriers may build the patterns of living things, but the one who gives them mind and the power to reproduce is the Universe Mother Spirit.
p36.022: When a plant or an animal dies, its life does not survive as an individual but returns to the forces of the universe. Whether a human being survives death depends only on whether an immortal soul has grown within the mind. Even celestial beings do not fully know where the spark of life comes from, but they do know that life flows from the Father through the Son and by the Spirit. It is good to remember that simply being alive right now is a wonderful gift from God.
